scenes.narration_text: Today we are looking at what happens to a whole number when you divide it by 10, and then by 100.
scenes.visual_description: A person speaking.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the presenter is speaking

source_refs.quote: Today we are looking at what happens to a whole number when you divide it by 10, and then by 100.

scenes.narration_text: Every whole number is built out of place value columns. From the right, we have ones, then tens, then hundreds, then thousands.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the place value columns.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the place value columns

source_refs.quote: Every whole number is built out of place value columns. From the right, we have ones, then tens, then hundreds, then thousands.

scenes.narration_text: Dividing by 10 makes a number ten times smaller.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the effect of dividing by 10.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the effect of dividing by 10

source_refs.quote: Dividing by 10 makes a number ten times smaller.

scenes.narration_text: When a number gets ten times smaller, every digit in it moves one place to the right.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the digits moving one place to the right.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the digits moving one place to the right

source_refs.quote: When a number gets ten times smaller, every digit in it moves one place to the right.

scenes.narration_text: The digits themselves never change. Their order never changes. Only the column each one sits in changes.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the digits in their new columns.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the digits in their new columns

source_refs.quote: The digits themselves never change. Their order never changes. Only the column each one sits in changes.

scenes.narration_text: For a whole number that ends in a zero, that zero moves off the end and disappears, because there is nothing to the right of the ones column for it to move into.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the zero moving off the end.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the zero moving off the end

source_refs.quote: For a whole number that ends in a zero, that zero moves off the end and disappears, because there is nothing to the right of the ones column for it to move into.

scenes.narration_text: Dividing by 100 makes a number one hundred times smaller.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the effect of dividing by 100.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the effect of dividing by 100

source_refs.quote: Dividing by 100 makes a number one hundred times smaller.

scenes.narration_text: One hundred is ten times ten. So dividing by 100 is the same as dividing by 10, and then dividing by 10 again.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the effect of dividing by 100 as two divisions by 10.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the effect of dividing by 100 as two divisions by 10

source_refs.quote: One hundred is ten times ten. So dividing by 100 is the same as dividing by 10, and then dividing by 10 again.

scenes.narration_text: That means every digit moves two places to the right instead of one.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the digits moving two places to the right.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the digits moving two places to the right

source_refs.quote: That means every digit moves two places to the right instead of one.

scenes.narration_text: A number with two zeros on the end loses both of them.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the two zeros moving off the end.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the two zeros moving off the end

source_refs.quote: A number with two zeros on the end loses both of them.

scenes.narration_text: It helps to know why this works rather than only that it works.
scenes.visual_description: A person speaking.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the presenter is speaking

source_refs.quote: It helps to know why this works rather than only that it works.

scenes.narration_text: A digit in the tens column is worth ten times what the same digit is worth in the ones column.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the place value of the digits.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the place value of the digits

source_refs.quote: A digit in the tens column is worth ten times what the same digit is worth in the ones column.

scenes.narration_text: So moving a digit one column to the right divides what it is worth by exactly ten.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the effect of moving a digit one column to the right.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the effect of moving a digit one column to the right

source_refs.quote: So moving a digit one column to the right divides what it is worth by exactly ten.

scenes.narration_text: That is the whole rule.
scenes.visual_description: A person speaking.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the presenter is speaking

scenes.narration_text: People often say 'dividing by 10 means crossing off a zero.'
scenes.visual_description: A person speaking.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the presenter is speaking

source_refs.quote: People often say 'dividing by 10 means crossing off a zero.'

scenes.narration_text: That works for whole numbers that end in a zero and it fails for every other number, because there is no zero to cross off.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the effect of crossing off a zero.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the effect of crossing off a zero

source_refs.quote: That works for whole numbers that end in a zero and it fails for every other number, because there is no zero to cross off.

scenes.narration_text: The reliable version is the one about columns: every digit shifts one place right for each ten you divide by.
scenes.visual_description: A diagram showing the digits shifting one place to the right.
scenes.media_rationale: image: the diagram shows the digits shifting one place to the right

source_refs.quote: The reliable version is the one about columns: every digit shifts one place right for each ten you divide by.

design_notes: The lesson starts with an introduction to the concept of dividing by 10 and 100. It then presents the rules for dividing by 10 and 100, using diagrams to illustrate the concepts. The lesson includes practice items for each of the learning outcomes, and ends with a summary of the rules. The practice items are designed to help the learner apply the rules to new situations, and the summary is designed to help the learner remember the rules.
